title: An auditable dependency and empirical census of SFT physics
description:
A complete, reproducible dependency and empirical census of the frozen SFT Physics branch: 347 Physics entries, 534transitive nodes, 3736 parent links, 234 empirical records and147 source identities.

Maria Smith derives complete ordered traversal and foundational reachability, reconstructs all 21 headline fields, proves the generator-successor comparison and assembles exact formal and empirical certificates. Includes every one of the 14 adverse-result or scope-boundary entries, all 6 legacy receipt shapes, all 147 source identities, four exact mutation controls, full 4,096/256 candidate grammars,491 empty-axiom audited declarations and pinned V3/V4 source and proofs.

Correspondence: Maria.smith.sftoe@gmail.com. SFT community and invitation: https://discord.gg/QCNkzq6kZC.
